[package]
name = "calc"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
description = "Evaluate 64-bit signed integer expressions, one per input line"
publish = false

[[bin]]
name = "calc"
path = "src/main.rs"

[profile.release]
opt-level = 3
lto = true
codegen-units = 1
panic = "abort"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Build the optimized calc release binary and install it as ./app.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

cargo build --release --quiet
cp target/release/calc app
chmod +x app
